evidence.codeReview: All dot/cross/distance methods use by-value for both self and other parameters across Vec2/Vec3/Vec4. All normalize methods use &self. No inconsistent parameter passing found.

summary: Tested 7 assertions: all 7 passed. VAL-MATH-003 (Quat::inverse delegates), VAL-MATH-005 (Vec parameter passing), VAL-MATH-006 (lerp &self), VAL-MATH-007 (Vec3::ONE), VAL-MATH-010 (Mat4 Copy), VAL-MATH-011 (Mat2 PartialEq), VAL-MATH-012 (Sphere derives). Notes: sse/vec3.rs does not exist (Vec3 has no SSE backend), so assertions VAL-MATH-006 and VAL-MATH-007 have inapplicable SSE grep targets — the assertions pass via scalar-only implementations.
